newFindingThisRun.landed: 2026-08-17, commit 91970f83d 'feat(trace): pure layout core for the timeline (#16124)'
newFindingThisRun.evidence: Sampled tests-web-client job 95672341601 (run 32124629182, 08-18 10:01 UTC). Immediately the #1 slowest client TEST FILE at 6.87s over just 12 tests, ahead of json-utils.clienttest.ts (6.66s over 106 tests). Its single test 'stays finite on degenerate shapes, degenerate boxes and compression' is the #1 slowest client test at 5.85s; a second test in the same file ('keeps every bar and label inside the box for every shape and width') is #4 at 995ms. The two together are ~11% of the client shard's 61.72s reported Duration.
newFindingThisRun.hypothesis: Both slow tests are nested loops over Object.entries(TIMELINE_SHAPES) x BOXES (x [false,true] for compress in the slowest one = 14 layout() calls per shape). The local run() helper calls prepareTimeline(roots, options.collapsed) on EVERY invocation, although roots and collapsed are loop-invariant within a shape -- classic repeated-per-iteration setup that could be hoisted to once per shape. TIMELINE_SHAPES includes a 'huge' shape with rowCount 10_000 (asserted in the 'positions only the mounted row window' test), and in the degenerate-shapes test layout() is called WITHOUT a rowRange, so all 10k rows are positioned on each of the 14 iterations.
newFindingThisRun.status: NOT VERIFIED, NOT PROPOSED AS A DIFF. See toolingBlockers.checkoutStaleness -- the entire TraceTimelineV2 directory is absent from the analyst's checkout, so the test cannot be run or timed here at all. Carried to next week as the top optimization candidate.
newFindingThisRun.nextStep: A run whose checkout contains TraceTimelineV2 should: (1) time the file as-is via `cd web && npx vitest run --project client src/features/traces/components/TraceTimelineV2/layout.clienttest.ts`; (2) check whether prepareTimeline's return value is mutated by layout() (if it is, hoisting is unsafe and the candidate dies); (3) if safe, hoist and re-time.

clientShardObservation.evidence: tests-web-client job 95672341601: 'Duration 61.72s (transform 7.79s, setup 8.43s, import 65.26s, tests 32.56s, environment 53.09s)' over 279 files / 3291 tests.
clientShardObservation.reading: Summed-across-workers phase totals. environment (53.09s, jsdom construction per file) exceeds the actual test execution total (32.56s), and import (65.26s) exceeds it by 2x. The client shard's cost is dominated by per-file environment + module-import overhead, not by test bodies. Individual slow-test fixes therefore have a low ceiling on this shard; the structural lever is reducing per-file jsdom construction (e.g. only files that need a DOM get the jsdom environment).
clientShardObservation.status: Observation only. Not proposed: changing the default environment for 279 files is neither small nor surgical, and correctness would need a full client-suite run to confirm. Recorded for a future week.
